chapter: The jazz war with Leonard Feather
title: Hodes's diary and writing the book about the jazz war
summary: They discuss Hodes's diary from this period and what it feels like to be attacked by one writer in every review.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Critics, polls and the jazz press

blocks.x: Does he have the diary that you kept during this time?
I've still got a diary. And I can't find all the screaming words, but I found one piece of paper where I says, what is he, God? I have decreed what jazz is and what isn't.

Well, you know, anybody put themselves in your place, I know I could, that if I was playing, a musician playing, and there was this one writer that every time I played was going to write something derogatory about me, my God --
